SELECT q.id, q.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, q.title, q.content, q.tags AS tag, q.is_top AS isTop, q.is_anonymous AS isAnonymous, q.user_id AS authorId, CASE WHEN q.is_anonymous = 1 THEN NULL ELSE u.real_name END AS authorName, q.reply_count AS replyCount, q.like_count AS likeCount, q.create_time AS createTime FROM qa_question q LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON q.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN course c ON q.course_id = c.id WHERE q.status = 1
AND q.course_id = #{dto.courseId}
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{dto.tag}, q.tags) > 0
AND (q.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') OR q.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY q.is_top DESC, q.create_time DESC, q.id DESC

SELECT q.id, q.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, q.title, q.content, q.tags AS tag, q.is_top AS isTop, q.is_anonymous AS isAnonymous, q.user_id AS authorId, CASE WHEN q.is_anonymous = 1 THEN NULL ELSE u.real_name END AS authorName, q.reply_count AS replyCount, q.like_count AS likeCount, q.create_time AS createTime FROM qa_question q LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON q.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN course c ON q.course_id = c.id WHERE q.id = #{id} AND q.status = 1

SELECT r.id, r.question_id AS questionId, r.user_id AS userId, u.real_name AS authorName, CASE WHEN u.role = 'teacher' OR u.role = 'admin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isTeacher, r.content, r.like_count AS likeCount, r.create_time AS createTime FROM qa_reply r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.question_id = #{questionId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.create_time ASC, r.id ASC
SELECT tags FROM qa_question WHERE status = 1 AND tags IS NOT NULL AND tags != ''
